name: Mossy Rounded Boulder
description: Medium riparian boulder, Wentworth medium-boulder class (~420 mm across): four granite layers approximating a rounded dome, continuous bryophyte mat on the crown, front and left-flank splash-zone moss patches, a thin soil-silt ring, and a lichen spot on the upper dome. Forest stream-bed prop.

parts.name: Granite body — base layer (widest, floor-contact)
parts.note: 420 mm width from dossier#body_dimensions (Wentworth medium-boulder range). Bottom face sits at y=0 (floor). Top face at y=0.08 — next layer stacks here.

parts.name: Granite body — mid layer
parts.note: Offset +x/−z and sunk to overlap body_base (bottom y=0.055) — lateral jitter breaks the concentric dome into an irregular rounded mass.

parts.name: Granite body — upper layer (narrowing)
parts.note: Offset −x/+z (opposite of body_mid) and sunk (bottom y=0.165) — the alternating lateral jitter is what kills the wedding-cake look.

parts.name: Granite body — crown (narrow apex)
parts.note: Offset +x/−z apex, sunk into body_upper (bottom y=0.255). Top face at y=0.325 — moss_cap straddles this.

parts.name: Bryophyte mat — crown cap
parts.note: 40 mm moss mat from dossier#moss_cover, following the offset apex. Straddling body_crown top face (y=0.325) by 4 mm: bottom y=0.321, center y=0.341, top y=0.361. No coplanar face (0.321 ≠ 0.325).

parts.name: Bryophyte patch — front splash-zone face
parts.note: Front-face moss (perpetually damp splash zone). Straddling body_base front face (z=0.195) by 4 mm: back face at z=0.191, center z=0.204. Vertically covers body_mid height range (y=0.08–0.20).

parts.name: Bryophyte patch — shaded left flank
parts.note: Left (shaded/north-facing) flank moss. Straddling body_base left face (x=-0.21) by 4 mm: right face at x=-0.206, center x=-0.219. Asymmetry vs the right side reads as organic.

parts.name: Riparian silt / mud contact plate
parts.note: 440×410 mm, 15 mm thick from dossier#soil_ring. Centred at y=0 so it straddles the floor plane (−7.5 mm to +7.5 mm) — boulder visually sits into soft substrate. Plate is wider/deeper than body_base (420×390 mm) so the soil ring is visible as a thin surrounding halo.

parts.name: Foliose lichen / algal crust spot
parts.note: 60 mm lichen patch from dossier#lichen_patch. Straddling moss_cap top (y=0.361) by 4 mm: bottom y=0.357, center y=0.367, top y=0.377. Offset from the apex centre for an organic irregular placement. grassGreen reads distinctly from the graniteMoss patches.

needs: Sourced h/w ratio for fluvially-rounded medium boulders — h=360 mm : w=420 mm (≈ 0.86) is design judgement, not independently measured
Moss mat thickness in Ukrainian/Dnieper-basin riparian zones — Glime (2017) global range 10–60 mm; region-specific source would sharpen the 40 mm value
